guarantees.statement: Every supported value and every allowed pair across independently selectable axes appears in at least one selected positive row.

fixedAxes.rationale: Issue #493 varies composition compatibility, not the issuer implementation mechanism reserved for #494+.
The holder-wallet boundary is fixed so private-witness and verification-location interactions remain attributable.
DID-method agility is not independently supported by the retained fixtures, so the method stays explicit while holder-binding and verification interactions vary.
The matrix uses fixture-only trust and must not turn coverage selection into a production trust-root claim.

prototype.hypothesis: Commitment-backed birth claims compose with explicit DID holder binding without exposing raw claim values.
limitations: Prototype evidence only; status is disabled and no production authority is selected.
prototype.exitCriterion: Reduce to the minimal explicit-holder conformance fixture or graduate through the credential-family ownership gates.

prototype.hypothesis: Hidden-holder birth credentials compose with authenticated status evidence and same-holder reference proofs.
limitations: Authority-attested status and same-holder remain reference evidence, not production authority approval.
prototype.exitCriterion: Retain only hidden-holder/status conformance evidence after reusable capabilities have independent consumers.

prototype.hypothesis: A commitment-only passport fixture exercises private-predicate composition and OpenID-shaped transcript binding without asserting product ownership.
limitations: Frozen migration evidence; OpenID-shaped framing is not OpenID conformance or a production passport use case.
prototype.exitCriterion: Move authoritative family ownership to the independent repository and remove duplicate implementation here.

prototype.hypothesis: The direct-claims laboratory proves the currently admitted Compact primitive and nested claim surface.
limitations: Synthetic direct-claims laboratory; no status, protocol, or production semantics.
prototype.exitCriterion: Keep only while it detects regressions not covered by reusable core consumer fixtures.

prototype.hypothesis: A minimal direct-claim family compiles through both canonical and offchain-DID composition surfaces.
limitations: Starter fixture only; offchain DID evidence does not imply resolver-backed DID authority.
prototype.exitCriterion: Reduce to the smallest compile fixture once public package consumer coverage supersedes it.

prototype.hypothesis: One family can compose signed public claims with independently opened commitment-backed claims.
limitations: Claim-representation laboratory; no status, transport, or production authority.
prototype.exitCriterion: Keep only until mixed-claim behavior is covered by reusable core conformance fixtures.

prototype.hypothesis: Academic direct-claim and privacy-profile fixtures expose the disclosure boundary needed by university composition evidence.
limitations: Private use-case evidence only; University v1 privacy scope remains governed separately and is not production-approved.
prototype.exitCriterion: Reduce to conformance fixtures or graduate only after security, schema, interoperability, CI, operational, and approval gates.

positiveRows.securityBoundary: Hidden-holder plus authenticated status is resolved only through an on-ledger verification profile.
Disabled status resolves without status package, provider, or deployment edges.
This row proves OpenID protocol-capability selection only; it does not prove transcript binding or OpenID conformance.
Same-holder is exercised as reference composition evidence, not as production authority approval.
A side-effecting row selects a contract-derived nullifier and an atomic replay provider.

unsupportedRationale.message: Hidden/private inputs cannot be sent to a public-only verifier.
Enabled status without authenticated freshness and proof evidence is unsupported.
Caller-controlled time cannot establish ledger-authoritative freshness.
Side effects without contract-derived atomic replay consumption are unsupported.
A disabled capability cannot retain package, provider, or deployment edges.
Ledger authority cannot be claimed for an uncommitted attempt.
A profile without identified tested conformance evidence is unsupported.
